COD.rationale: Identified content, its organization (coordinate pattern) and a separate origin/status field are explicitly present and co-identified.

A.rationale: An explicit processing/attention-related origin (command_estimate) is linked to the same candidate content entry.

C.rationale: Content items (color assignments to coordinate sets) are directly identified with explicit attribute labels.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is provided separately from the content coordinate listings, distinguishing content from its status/source.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is presented as coordinate patterns (organized spatial mappings) for the named referent/time.
